title: Prove sharp read savings for encoded Gaussian inverse setup (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped semantics/resource proof with exact finite corroboration. Skip already settled identity columns in PR3851's encoded positive-pivot Gaussian inverse:

```diff
 at pivot k, normalize and eliminate over columns
-0 <= j < 2n
+k <= j < 2n
```

The exact saving is `sum_k k(1+m_k)` matrix reads, where `m_k` counts nonzero off-diagonal factors. The sharp all-dimension bounds are `n(n-1)/2` and `n^2(n-1)/2`. Numerical acceptance, exact output records, arithmetic and matrix writes agree with the predecessor. Additional scratch is explicit.

For the complete literal `4I+J` physical fixture, matrix reads fall from 236 to 212 and matrix writes remain 80. Including input construction, output consumption and cleanup, pooled tape reads fall from 947301 to 922401, writes from 187399 to 182739, and unit head moves from 869032 to 846336. Peak pool leases rise from 34 to 36. These are finite pooled-record counters, not a complete instruction or recursive supplier invoice. Nine alternating cold-process pairs give identical complete outputs and zero errors, but the wall-time comparison is inconclusive. No speedup or new kappa is claimed.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Jose Manuel / jmbarrancoml's PR3851 for the exact inverse, physical Gaussian setup and retained rational/tape/word-product lineage. Gauss-Jordan elimination and its identity-column invariant are classical. Predecessor scientific results are cited premises, not audited deliverables. Frozen sources and selected frontier are unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: settled leading columns were repeatedly read and then skipped as zero.
- After: the new suffix iterator avoids exactly those reads. A written induction proves bit-identical augmented states and both sharp bounds.
- Ten paired encoded fixtures, 81 exact rational matrices and eight rejecting executions pass. Every physical output is checked against a separate rational trace and both inverse products. Source preservation, scratch cleanup, the added peak leases and full pooled meters are checked under sealed constructors and a host-decoding ban.

Reproduce from the repository root with CPython 3.12 and the standard library. Another machine may replace this interpreter path:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/gaussian-inverse-settled-columns/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/gaussian-inverse-settled-columns/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-inverse-settled-columns
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/gaussian-inverse-settled-columns --check-source-history --check-modes
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/gaussian-inverse-settled-columns/benchmark.py --pairs 9
```

Warning-strict normal and optimized direct and registered checks pass locally. The direct commands take 1.652 and 1.708 seconds, below their 120-second caps. Committed bytes, modes and declared source ancestry pass for all fifteen package/input files at `dc7d0f681a7b326b475863074c825f9824d21a80`. Official export integrity and all five declared inputs pass. Both direct modes pass in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH. Two source-corruption and two semantic-corruption executions reject; all sixteen exported files retain their bytes and modes. The checker prints a generated source-hash-bound receipt and writes no package files. All five live source inputs are declared. Timing is a separate experiment, not a CI threshold.

## Limitations

The theorem preserves the positive-pivot numerical domain with adequate scratch. A pool sized only for the original peak need not suffice. Cold source authentication/extraction dominates the tiny benchmark; no full Gaussian preparation or production-size caller was measured. The pooled meters do not count every machine instruction or prove a universal decrease in all tape costs.

Native all-column validity, Gaussian numerical admission, production pages, complete caller, compiler, precision/tape/stock and all five selected framework assumptions remain open. No selected scientific cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human review or formal proof-kernel review is claimed. The universal result is the written proof, with finite corroboration.

## Open next questions

- Implement one fully charged exact streamed row update without increasing peak scratch. Start with its borrowed records, scans and cleanup; no such primitive is supplied.
- Bind this inverse to one actual preparation page and compare complete bytes, ownership and pooled meters. The complete physical caller and production preparation remain blockers.

## Related open work

No open PR found in the bounded live searches studies this encoded inverse's settled-column traversal or saved-read quantity. Adjacent work is distinguished without additional computations:

- #6228 normalizes rational Stein generators for Gaussian matrices. It changes coefficient size and norm bounds, while this result changes exact setup traversal; there is no common computed count.
- #1758 proposes structured Gaussian boundary solvers in a historical T74 assembly. This component preserves PR3851's dense positive-pivot inverse and makes no asymptotic structured-solve or assembly claim.

The advance [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19279747) records the target. Canonical main was refreshed at `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`, priority revision 8. Live PR/Discussion, main README, merged-term and local reservation checks found no matching target within their bounded coverage. The cached remote snapshot covers 338 open PRs and 5959 Discussion records; sparse local coverage is incomplete. Unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs are outside the novelty check.

## CI notes

CI pending. No hosted pass is claimed. Local validation and exact publication checks are recorded above; hosted replay will run the registered normal and optimized conformance commands.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. This adds one opt-in package and changes no shared code, frozen predecessor or selected-frontier record.
